en: Job 34

p.src: 1  Moreover Elihu answered,

en: Moreover Elihu answered,
u.src: 1  Moreover Elihu answered,

p.src: 2  “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.

en: “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.
u.src: 2  “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.

p.src: 3  For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.

ja: わうように、 耳は言葉を吟味するからだ。
en: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.
u.src: 3  For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.

p.src: 4  Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good.

ja: が良いことか、ともに見極めよう。
en: Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good.
u.src: 4  Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good.

p.src: 5  For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right.

en: For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right.
u.src: 5  For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right.

p.src: 6  Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’

en: Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’
u.src: 6  Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’

p.src: 7  What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,

ja: がほかにいるだろうか。 彼は水のように嘲りを飲み、
en: What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,
u.src: 7  What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,

p.src: 8  who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?

en: who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?
u.src: 8  who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?

p.src: 9  For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’

en: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’
u.src: 9  For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’

p.src: 10  “Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

ja: してない。 全能者が不義を行うことも、決してない。
en: “Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.
u.src: 10  “Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

p.src: 11  For the work of a man he will give to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.

en: For the work of a man he will give to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.
u.src: 11  For the work of a man he will give to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.

p.src: 12  Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.

en: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.
u.src: 12  Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.

p.src: 13  Who put him in charge of the earth? Or who has appointed him over the whole world?

ja: を委ねたのか。 誰が神を
en: Who put him in charge of the earth? Or who has appointed him over the whole world?
u.src: 13  Who put him in charge of the earth? Or who has appointed him over the whole world?

p.src: 14  If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,

en: If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,
u.src: 14  If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,

p.src: 15  all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.

en: all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.
u.src: 15  all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.

p.src: 16  “If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words.

en: “If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words.
u.src: 16  “If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words.

p.src: 17  Should even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty,

ja: が治めるべきだろうか。 あなたは
en: Should even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty,
u.src: 17  Should even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty,

p.src: 18  who says to a king, ‘Vile!’ or to nobles, ‘Wicked!’?

en: who says to a king, ‘Vile!’ or to nobles, ‘Wicked!’?
u.src: 18  who says to a king, ‘Vile!’ or to nobles, ‘Wicked!’?

p.src: 19  He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor, for they all are the work of his hands.

en: He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor, for they all are the work of his hands.
u.src: 19  He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor, for they all are the work of his hands.

p.src: 20  In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.

ja: らは真夜中であっても、
en: In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.
u.src: 20  In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.

p.src: 21  “For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings.

ja: の上にあり、 そのすべての
en: “For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings.
u.src: 21  “For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings.

p.src: 22  There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

ja: も、 深い暗がりもない。
en: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
u.src: 22  There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

p.src: 23  For he doesn’t need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.

ja: くために御前に呼び出すのに、 それ以上人を調べる
en: For he doesn’t need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.
u.src: 23  For he doesn’t need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.

p.src: 24  He breaks mighty men in pieces in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.

ja: たちを測り知れない仕方で粉々に
き、 他の者たちを彼らの
en: He breaks mighty men in pieces in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.
u.src: 24  He breaks mighty men in pieces in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.

p.src: 25  Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

en: Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.
u.src: 25  Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

p.src: 26  He strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of others;

ja: らを悪者として、 ほかの人々が見ている前で
en: He strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of others;
u.src: 26  He strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of others;

p.src: 27  because they turned away from following him, and wouldn’t pay attention to any of his ways,

ja: うことから背を向け、 神のどの
en: because they turned away from following him, and wouldn’t pay attention to any of his ways,
u.src: 27  because they turned away from following him, and wouldn’t pay attention to any of his ways,

p.src: 28  so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted.

en: so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted.
u.src: 28  so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted.

p.src: 29  When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? He is over a nation or a man alike,

ja: えられるとき、誰が罪に定められようか。
られようか。 神は国の上にも
en: When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? He is over a nation or a man alike,
u.src: 29  When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? He is over a nation or a man alike,

p.src: 30  that the godless man may not reign, that there be no one to ensnare the people.

ja: を罠にかけることがないために。
en: that the godless man may not reign, that there be no one to ensnare the people.
u.src: 30  that the godless man may not reign, that there be no one to ensnare the people.

p.src: 31  “For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.

ja: にこう言っただろうか。 『
は罪を負った。だが、もう過ちを
en: “For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.
u.src: 31  “For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.

p.src: 32  Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?

ja: えてください。 もし
en: Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?
u.src: 32  Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?

p.src: 33  Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you know.

ja: あなたがそれを拒んだからといって、
いがあなたの望みどおりになされるべきか。
ぶのはあなたであって、
ではない。 だから、あなたが
en: Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you know.
u.src: 33  Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you know.

p.src: 34  Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me:

ja: 々は私に言い、 そうだ、
en: Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me:
u.src: 34  Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me:

p.src: 35  ‘Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.’

en: ‘Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.’
u.src: 35  ‘Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.’

p.src: 36  I wish that Job were tried to the end, because of his answering like wicked men.

ja: みられることを願う。 彼が悪者たちのように
en: I wish that Job were tried to the end, because of his answering like wicked men.
u.src: 36  I wish that Job were tried to the end, because of his answering like wicked men.

p.src: 37  For he adds rebellion to his sin. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God.”

en: For he adds rebellion to his sin. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God.”
u.src: 37  For he adds rebellion to his sin. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God.”
